title: Target lot alignment does not validate rebalance delta for existing odd-lot positions
disposition: Freeze whether lot applies to target and/or delta. With the declared trading-lot/full-close-only policy, reject non-full-close nonaligned delta explicitly before success; define delta=0 odd-lot hold separately. Keep q_target=q_current+delta. An alternative trade-lattice quantizer needs explicit design approval and all post-round checks; no silent partial-odd-lot permission or P5-only deferral.
